text:
maya patel: Quick rollout update — we flipped "strand-pipeline" on canary pools at 06:00 PT. Early results: p50 down ~9%, p99 down ~14%, and average token cost down ~22% for our standard text-gen workloads (gpt-medium family). Posting a short summary + links.

samir rao: nice!! what's the risk profile? any errors or tail spikes?

maya patel: @samir small transient blip: 0.3% increase in 500s for long-context (>4k) requests during the first 10m. Root cause was background kernel prefetch racing with eviction. We added a simple backoff + sequential prefetch; fix deployed to canary at 06:12 and errors dropped back to baseline. No customer-facing impact. :white_check_mark:

infra-bot: Canary metrics snapshot (06:30 PT): cpu down 11%, gpu-util +6% (better packing), token-cost-per-1M $0.78 -> $0.61. Throughput up ~5% on mixed traffic. Metrics: https://redwood-infra/metrics/canary/1987654321

jess chen: did we test embeddings and very short prompts? want to make sure no regressions for tiny requests / PLG flows.

maya patel: @jess yes — embeddings stable, short prompts got a small p50 win (~3%). Strand scheduler includes a fast-path for <=64 token requests so tail isn't impacted.

ben l: what's the deployment plan for Dedicated customers? is this opt-in? config change?

maya patel: Dedicated is opt-in for now. Use agentctl to flip per-pool: 
```
agentctl feature set strand_pipeline=true --pool dedicated_v2 --until 2026-04-05T00:00Z
```
Recommend 2% traffic ramp for first 24h then 10% increments. We'll auto-fallback to legacy kernel on any elevated error rates. Docs: https://redwood.dev/docs/runtimes/strand-pipeline

samir rao: any model families that regressed in canary? curious about sparsity/sparse-attn kernels.

maya patel: Good call — we saw a small p99 regression (+5%) on older sparse-attention kernels. Runtime policy will exclude those kernels from the strand path and route them to legacy execution. We're building a compat-list and an automated test to keep that list updated.

jess chen: i'll add a nightly eval job to the perf-suite to catch regressions across model families and contexts. will add checks for latency and accuracy diffs.

maya patel: thanks everyone. I'll post a short postmortem + rollout playbook in #eng-runtime later today. Retrospective scheduled: 2026-04-02 15:00 PT. :tada: @samir @jess @ben l

infra-bot: Feature toggle events: strand_pipeline enabled on canary at 1987654321, promoted to 5% at 1987654340, monitoring watch notified.

ben l: awesome work :clap: — can we add a short blurb for the weekly product update? ops numbers look great.

maya patel: will do, i'll draft a 2-paragraph blurb and share for review.
